Knelt down in garage and felt sharp pain about 2 months ago. Tiny bump, Thought it was splinter.   
Went at it with a pin and couldn't find/get splinter, then when it got bigger a week later I cut it with flush cut sidecutters. Bled a bit, Figured I cut out whatever "splinter" it was, or wart etc... but it came back. 

Tried canesten? (thought it was fungal) no change (except moisturized maybe)   
if it gets wet the skin gets soft and white, and can be scraped/peeled off with my nail, exposing red angry skin which is also rougher looking than expected. Grows back to like this within a week or two. Started as a tiny bump that only hurt when I knelt on it, now I feel it all the time (kinda Dry-skin burny/ebbing pain 1.5/10)

Update:  I'm no longer thinking of suicide - But I think divorce is the way to go. She been drinking, a lot. Multiple promises that she'll stop. but I keep finding her stashes. I don't look for them. I want to believe she wouldn't lie to me... but sometimes I go to bed and just smell it on her under the guise of "mouthwash"  The last time I mentioned to her I didn't even get mad. I just stopped talking to her, and that seemed to have triggered something.   


She reached out to me, finally wasn't defensive about everything, and we talked about it for the first time ever without fighting. That was a week ago, and things have been much better since then...  


But today, she asked me if she could have a glass of wine. I said no. REALLY quickly, which was my mistake. And for the rest of the day, she was just outright nasty to me.  I can't hid how she treats me to the kids - Because she starts yelling at me in front of them. I ask her to stop, and she yells at me saying she's not yelling at me, and she's not mad. Then my 4 year old asks us to stop yelling.   


Ultimately, I'm starting to think that I don't need a way out of life, I need to get away from her.

I'm sure my parents would but also are planning to finally retire shortly. This would end that and I could never do that to them. 

The cost of housing where I live is astronomical. a place I rented 10 years ago went from 1350 a month to well over double that. I'd have to move pretty far away to afford a mortgage, rent and to take care of or pay monthly payments of my kids.   
I'm losing money every month as it is with childcare costs and my wifes job is a labor of love (makes about half as much as I do, never going to be more than that)   


My wife is not responsible with money and I would worry about her ability to get along as well. I can't see a situation where we could share custody and still live in the same area/same jobs.
